messages:
Maya: quick intake — proposing we triage merlin-45b-quant for priority bring-up. target: embeddings + chat for search & code assist. can folks give scores by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Dmitri: can you post the scoring rubric? want infra and quant risk visible so we weigh them appropriately.
Maya: posting rubric (weights) below — call out disagreements:
```
categories (weight):
- product_impact (3)
- infra_cost (2)
- latency_risk (2)
- quant_risk (3)
- eval_pass_rate (3)
- dataset_coverage (2)

sample scores (0-5) -> weighted sum
baseline (atlas-40b): 3,4,4,2,4,3 => weighted_total = 49
merlin-45b-quant (guesst.): 4,3,3,2,5,3 => weighted_total = 51
```
Zoe: ran a tiny 4-bit experiment on a dev shard overnight — code EM improved ~1.6% but perplexity variance is higher on some long-form prompts. quantization looks promising but we need more runs across prompt lengths and diversity slices.
Kai: infra note — merlin-45b-quant on our recommended QAT path still needs ~50GB VRAM for decent batch. we may need model sharding or a 2x-GPU flavor for Dedicated. fallback plan: offer merlin-30b as a lower-cost variant.
Nora: rollout gating suggestion: require a feature-flagged canary + metrics: p95_latency, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1M_tokens, relevance_score_delta, hallucination_rate. propose SLO p95 < 250ms for hosted tier.
Evan: quick eval summary: safety pass 92% (baseline 94%), hallucination delta +1.8% on QA sets, code-gen exact-match +1.2% — so mixed tradeoffs.
Dmitri: ok, I'll own the quant experiments and run 3 seeds to produce averaged metrics by Tue. I'll also produce an infra footprint matrix and a fallback mapping to merlin-30b.
triage-bot: Created TICKET-2381 — "merlin-45b onboarding: quant experiments + infra footprint". assignees: @dmitri, @zoe. due_date: 2024-08-01. :ticket:
Maya: plan / next steps:
- Dmitri: quant runs + final weighted scores (due Tue)
- Zoe: expand prompt diversity for evals (safety + hallucination focus)
- Kai: infra cost model + shard options
- Nora: rollout gating + metrics dashboard
I'll consolidate and post final prioritization matrix on Wed AM. if weighted_score > 50 we move this into a high-priority slot this quarter. :rocket:
Zoe: noted — adding diversity slices now.
Kai: prototyping a 2x-GPU Dedicated flavor and will post perf/nvm numbers tomorrow.
Maya: thanks all — tagging @eng-platform for FYI on potential capacity change. :eyes:
